title: Google Hits 50% IPv6
summary: This article reports that Google has achieved 50% IPv6 adoption milestone, marking a significant turning point in the global transition from IPv4 to IPv6 protocol. The data from APNIC (Asia-Pacific Network Information Centre) demonstrates that IPv6 deployment is accelerating among major tech companies.
problem_solved: The article addresses the IPv4 address exhaustion problem and documents progress in the transition to IPv6 which provides a virtually unlimited address space.
why_valuable: Reaching 50% IPv6 adoption at Google signals that the internet is making meaningful progress toward solving the IPv4 address shortage crisis and preparing for future growth.
